g.text: NORTHSTAR RETAIL AI | Lab 2 Data & Feature Engineering
Target design from the latest Canvas guide · Lab 1 foundation + Lab 2 additions
GRAY: network egress GREEN: data movement DASHED: metadata / script / service access
NETWORK connection → private subnet + Glue SG
Glue SG requires self-referencing all-port ingress
Outbound: private subnet → NAT → public route → IGW → Internet / AWS APIs
Private compute pulls images via NAT
S3, Glue Catalog and Feature Store are regional
services outside the VPC. The two Glue jobs
execute on the private workers shown at left.
Dashed service links are logical API access; egress
All S3 prefix nodes share: northstar-dev-data-{account-id} · Lab 1 bucket extended
Versioning ON · SSE-S3 · all public access blocked · S3 is outside the VPC
datacapture/ retention is set now; its writer arrives in Lab 5.
Label 1 = no purchase; train/test splitting happens in Lab 3.
03 GLOBAL IAM · exact role names and access boundaries
S3 artifacts/glue/: read only; no artifacts/ writes
Glue + GetConnection · EC2 ENIs / tags · logs
Studio execution · ECR image pulls · logs
No writes to raw/ or processed/
S3 artifacts/: read only · CloudWatch Logs: write
No S3 writes, endpoint calls or processing job starts
Observation role; execution role is a later-lab concern
Terraform modules: vpc · storage · iam · sagemaker · glue · feature_store | Design diagram, not deployment evidence
